Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:173210
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 41790 of 2023
Applicant :- Kshitij Singh

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Kumar Srivastava,Atul Pandey,Dhananjay Singh,Satyendra Nar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Amit Kumar Srivastava and Sri Atul Pandey, learned counsels for the applicant and Sri R.N. Srivastava, learned AGA for the State.
3.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 228 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Lanka,
District Varanasi during pendency of the trial.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged on 15.06.2023 at 17.26 hours against applicant and his family members and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the deceased on 29.05.2021 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for demand of Rs. 10 lakhs and on 14.06.2023 at about 8.30 PM applicant and his family members hanged the deceased due to want of dowry.
Kshitij Singh vs State Of U.P. on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77329483/

sentences.text:
5. Learned counsels for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter along with other family members.
6.
They further submitted that some dispute arose between husband and wife and as deceased was short tampered lady, therefore, she hanged herself and died.
They further submitted that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.

7. They further submitted that immediately after the incident on 15.06.2023 at 12.26 hours in the night applicant informed the police and this fact is evident from the G.D. No. 39, which has been annexed at page 64 of the paper-book but in spite of the information given by the applicant no inquest was conducted and inquest was conducted after lodgement of the FIR, which was lodged on 15.06.2023 at 17.26 hours.

8. They further submitted that even from the G.D. entry dated 15.6.2023 at 13.21 hours, which has been annexed at page-8 of the supplementary affidavit dated 07.11.2023, it reflects that when police arrived at spot then it was found that door was locked and subsequently deceased, who was hanging from the fan, was put down on the floor.

9. They next submitted, it appears, when informant came to know about the death of his daughter then he lodged the FIR of the present case on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture.

10. They further submitted that in the present matter applicant is in jail since 17.06.2023 i.e. for last more than a year and till date not even charges could be framed and this fact is evident from the order-sheet of the case, which has been annexed along with supplementary affidavit dated 16.10.2024.
11.
They further submitted that applicant is not having any criminal history.

12. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two and half years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that deceased died due to hanging and even before lodgment of the FIR applicant himself informed the police that his wife hanged herself.
13 . Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that in the present matter applicant is in jail since 17.06.2023 i.e. for last more than a year and till date not even charges could be framed.
14. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

15. However, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within two and half years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but from the post mortem report, it reflects that deceased died due to hanging,

sentences.text:
therefore, prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicidal death and argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant with regard to alleged suicide committed by the deceased, cannot be completely ruled out at this stage.
16.
Further, record also suggests that immediately after the incident applicant informed the police and after several hours FIR of the present case was lodged.
17. Record also suggests that in the present matter applicant is in jail since 17.06.2023 i.e. for last more than a year but till date even trial could not be commenced.
18. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history.

19. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
20. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

21. Let the applicant - Kshitij Singh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
22. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

23. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 5.11.2024 AK Pandey  Kshitij Singh vs State Of U.P. on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77329483/
